in_arabic.name: مهذب
in_arabic.long_meaning: مهذب هو اسم عربي مشتق من الفعل هذب الذي يعني توجيه شيء أو شخص إلى الصواب والخير، ولهذا فإن 名 المهذب يرمز إلى الشخص الذي يرشد الآخرين إلى الطريق الصحيح ويقودهم إلى الخير والفضيلة، وهو اسم شائع في الثقافة الإسلامية ويعبر عن القيم الروحية والأخلاقية العالية

in_urdu.name: مہذب
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہذب ایک عربي نام ہے جو فعل ہذب سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب ہے راہ دیکھانا، اس نام کا مطلب ہے نیک راہ دیکھانے والا، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت مشہور ہے اور اس سے اخلاقی اور روحانی قیمتیں ظاہر ہوتی ہیں

in_hindi.name: मुहज़्ज़ब
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहज़्ज़ब एक अरबी नाम है जो फعل हذब से उत्पन्न हुआ है, जिसका अर्थ है सही रास्ता दिखाना, इस नाम का अर्थ है सही रास्ता दिखाने वाला, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है और इससे नैतिक और आध्यात्मिक मूल्यों को दर्शाया जाता है

in_pashto.name: مهذب
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهذب د عربي نوم دی چې د فعل هذب څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د دې معنا ده د لور د لار ښودل، دا نوم د اسلامی کلتور کې ډېر مشهور دی او د دې څخه اخلاقی او روحانی ارزښتونه څرگندېږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Muhazzib carries a noble and magnanimous meaning. It suggests a person who bestows honor upon others and contributes to making the world a more beautiful place by recognizing and uplifting people around them. This essence is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings, which stress the importance of kindness, respect, and chanting good over evil. The Islamic community values highly those individuals who practice selflessness and strive to elevate their communities and fellow beings, often reflected in numerous historical accounts of great Islamic scholars, leaders, and characters.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muhazzib carries a profoundly deep and spiritual impact. It is a reminder of the noble scope and ultimate goal of human existence, which is to glorify and serve our Creator. By embodying the qualities of a Muhazzib, one can engage in acts of kindness, intentionally contributing to the honor and guidance of their communities. As this learning and growth journey progresses, each person comes closer to fostering a deeper connection with their inner Selves and with Allah, as it reflects a continuous path of spiritual development. Thus, the name Muhazzib, with its beautiful semantic meaning, challenges us to reflect upon the significance of uplifting and honoring others, to look within ourselves, and to strive for continual spiritual growth.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa Al-Nihayah, Volume 10, Page 227-228. The name Muhazzib carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.time_period: During the reign of Caliph Umar Ibn Abdulaziz (683-684 AD).
historical_references.context: Muhazzib Al-Nadhr was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who was known for his piety and generosity. He was appointed as the governor of Kufa by Caliph Umar Ibn Abdulaziz. During his governorship, he distributed the state's treasury among the poor and needy, and provided relief to the victims of a famine. He was called Muhazzib (lit. 'the illuminator') because of his acts of kindness and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Baladhuri's Ansab Al-Ashraf, Volume 7, Page 362-363. The name Muhazzib carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Muhazzib Al-Nadhr was a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and a notable figure in the early Islamic community. He was known for his piety and generosity. During the Famine of Amwas (616 AD), he ransomed prisoners of war and distributed their ransoms among the needy. He was later appointed as the governor of Kufa by Caliph Umar Ibn Abdulaziz. He continued his charitable activities during his governorship and was known as Muhazzib (lit. 'the illuminator') due to his acts of kindness and generosity.
